paragraphs: The official rate for the Bolivian boliviano rose from 6.93145623 per dollar on 5 Jul 2026 to 9.90116293 on 8 Jul 2026. That was a rise of 42.8439%. Our code spotted the change on 8 Jul. The rate reached 12.12569263 on 5 Aug 2026, which was 74.9372% above the 5 Jul level.
We found no announcement for 8 Jul 2026.
